cohort: The study included 195 age- and sex-matched pairs of children, with cases having juvenile spondyloarthritis (JSpA) and controls without JSpA, with a mean age of 13.0 years.
finding: Exclusive breastfeeding for more than 6 months was independently and significantly associated with a lower chance of developing juvenile spondyloarthritis.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was significantly associated with lower JSpA disease activity at presentation.
followup_time: Mean age of 13.0 years at outcome assessment
